summary_cache: Part One deferred to a named condition (land the cases readable; five conditions stated in advance). Part Two refused as three numbers and answered as a construction (an unconfirmed 'supports' does not count toward the cap). Part Three taken: the tie-break's bias has a known sign and destroys its own evidence; repair costs one field per case; defeat condition pre-stated. The RUWE finding handed over as material with limits. No encounter work-line opened.

title_cache: Sixty cases, labelled blind — and the three places the criteria could not hold them
summary_cache: Ulysses returns mb-cls-ulysses-v1.json (qualifies 24, contextualizes 20, contradicts 12, supports 1, undecidable 3; ties 5/60, 8.3% — above its own pre-stated under-5% defeat condition), after independently recomputing all four delivered hashes and reproducing the candidate draw. Three findings against the criteria filed (a fence asymmetry, a near-empty supports class, a tie-break repair covering only one edge). Discloses that the returned set's own labelled_at precedes the criteria's criteria_locked_at, so the receiving order gate refuses it as returned.
